y-m-60-03.title: Imisa lambar oo qiyaas ah ayaan aaminaa?
y-m-60-03.topic: Qiyaasaha logaritamyada caadiga ah iyo tirada lambarrada: intee ayaan aamini karnaa qiyaas?
y-m-60-03.goal: Baro in khalad yar oo ku jira qiyaas uu beddeli karo gunaanadka marka n weynaato, hel kiisaska gunaanadku ku kala duwan yahay, oo sheeg shuruudaha qiyaas lagu aamini karo.
y-m-60-03.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno imisa lambar ayuu 2ⁿ leeyahay. Tirada lambarrada tiro dhan oo togan N waa (qaybta dhan ee log N) + 1, sidaas darteed tirada lambarrada 2ⁿ waa (qaybta dhan ee n × log 2) + 1. Qiimaha dhabta ah ee log 2 waa 0.30102999566…, laakiin Soyoung ayaa isticmaalay qiyaasta 0.301 oo helay tirada lambarrada iyadoo lagu darayo 1 qaybta dhan ee n × 0.301. (Qaybta dhan waa tirada dhan ee ka horreysa dhibicda tobanlaha. Tusaale: qaybta dhan ee 9.03 waa 9.)

y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.a: Maadaama qiyaas la isticmaalay khalad ayaa jira, sidaas darteed ma ogaan karno tirada lambarrada ilaa aan ku xisaabino qiimaha saxda ah
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.a: Qiimaha dhabta ah horey ayaa loo bixiyey, sidaas darteed isbarbar dhigidda labada wax-ku-dhufasho waxay sheegaysaa cabbirka khaladka. Ka fikir in khaladku ku filan yahay in uu beddelo gunaanadka.

y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.c: Qiyaasku wuu ka yar yahay qiimaha dhabta ah, sidaas darteed tirada dhabta ah ee lambarrada had iyo jeer waa mid ka badan tan lagu helay qiyaasta
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.c: Qiime yar oo ka yar ma beddelo qaybta dhan waajib ahaan. Ka fikir waxa dhici lahaa si qaybta dhan u beddesho.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.d: 0.301 iyo qiimaha dhabta ahi waxay ku heshiiyaan ilaa meesha saddexaad ee jajab tobanlaha, sidaas darteed tirada lambarrada waa isku mid n kasta

In qiyaas la aamini karo waxay ku xiran tahay cabbirka khaladka iyo sida qiimaha la xisaabiyey uga fog yahay tiro dhan.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo geli laba tiro dabiici ah oo kala duwan n oo tirada lambarrada 2ⁿ ee lagu helay habka Soyoung (adigoo isticmaalaya 0.301) iyo qiimaha dhabta ah (adigoo isticmaalaya 0.30102999566…) ay kala duwan yihiin. (Tirada lambarrada = qaybta dhan ee n × log 2 + 1)

y-m-60-05.title: Wareegga soo noqnoqda ee heerka badda: intee in le'eg ayay xogtu na sheegi kartaa?
y-m-60-05.topic: Wareegga hawsha sine: intee in le'eg ayaa wareegga lagu go'aamin karaa cabbirro lagu qaaday waqtiyo joogto ah
y-m-60-05.goal: Baro in xogta lagu cabbiray kala dheeraad ay wareegga go'aamin karin, hagaaji xukunkaaga marka xog dheeraad ah timaado, oo si toos ah u barbar dhig qaababka musharaxiinta iyo cabbirrada.
y-m-60-05.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan cabbirno heerka badda (m) dekedda oo aan ku muujino qaacidada qaabka h(t) = 3 + 2·sin(2πt/T). t waa waqtiga (saacado) laga bilaabo saacadda 0, T-na waa wareegga (saacado). Cabbirrada waxaa loo wareejiyay cutubyada 0.1 m waxayna kala duwanaan karaan qiyaastii ±0.2 m sababtoo ah mowjadaha. Ujeeddadu waa in la go'aamiyo T. (Sida loo akhriyo: 2πt/T waa '2π t kor T'.)

y-m-60-04.thinking.0: Go'aami haddii macluumaadku ku filan yahay
y-m-60-04.title: Haddii sin θ yahay 3/5, cos θ ma lagu go'aamiyay si gaar ah?
y-m-60-04.topic: Xidhiidhka u dhexeeya hawlaha saddex-xagalka: shuruudaha cos θ iyo tan θ lagu go'aamiyo marka sin θ la bixiyo
y-m-60-04.goal: Muuji, adigoo helaya dhammaan qiimayaasha suurtagalka ah, in qiimaha sine oo keliya uusan go'aamin qiimayaasha cosine iyo tangent si gaar ah, oo kala dooro macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee go'aamiya qiimayaasha.
y-m-60-04.material: Xagalka θ waa xagal guud (muhiim ma aha radian ama darajo) iyo sin θ = 3/5. Harin wuxuu yidhi, "Maadaama sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos θ = 4/5 iyo tan θ = 3/4." (Sida loo akhriyo: sin θ waa 'sine theta', sin²θ waa 'sine theta labajibaaran', 3/5-na waa 'saddex shanaad'.)
y-m-60-04.thinking.2: Kala dooro shuruudaha dheeraadka ah ee go'aamiya gabagabada
y-m-60-04.prereq.0: Qeexidda hawlaha saddex-xagalka ee xagallada guud iyo calaamadahooda rubuc kasta
y-m-60-04.prereq.2: Kani waa heer adag oo hawshan ah (H3), ma aha qoondayn fasal, waxayna u qaadanaysaa inaad dhammaysay cutubka hawlaha saddex-xagalka.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah xukunka ugu habboon ee gabagabada Harin?
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hel qiimaha cos²θ, kadibna tiri imisa tiro ayay qiimahaas leeyihiin marka la labajibaaro.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qor rubuc kee ayaa ka kooban xagallo sin θ ay yihiin togan.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.a: Sax. Ee sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos θ = 4/5 iyo tan θ = 3/4 waa la go'aamiyay
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.a: Hubi haddii ay jirto hal tiro oo keliya oo labajibaarkeedu yahay 16/25.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.b: cos θ wuxuu ka soo baxaa laba qiimood, 4/5 iyo −4/5, laakiin caadadu waa in la qaato xididka labajibaaran ee togan, sidaas darteed waxaa lagu go'aamiyay 4/5
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.b: Caadada qaadashada xididka togan waxay ku saabsan tahay calaamadda xididka labajibaaran. Hubi haddii xagal cos θ uu yahay taban uu buuxin karo sin θ = 3/5.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.c: cos θ wuxuu noqon karaa 4/5 ama −4/5, sidaas darteed macluumaadka la bixiyay oo keliya kuma go'aamiyo hal qiime
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.d: Haddii sin θ = 3/5, markaas θ waa lama huraan xagal rubuca koowaad ah, sidaas darteed qiimaha Harin waa sax
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.d: Hubi haddii xagallada sin θ ay yihiin togan ay ku jiraan rubuca koowaad oo keliya.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.explain: Maadaama sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos²θ = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25, sidaas darteed cos θ = 4/5 ama −4/5. Haddii sin θ>0, θ wuxuu ku jiraa rubuca koowaad ama labaad, sidaas darteed labada kiis waa suurtagal.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo gali laba labo-lab oo qiimayaal suurtagal ah oo kala duwan (cos θ, tan θ) ee xagal θ oo sin θ = 3/5. (Jajabka u qor jajab tobanle. Tusaale: 3/5 = 0.6)
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hel cos²θ, kadibna hel dhammaan qiimayaasha cos θ ee bixiya.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.1: cos θ kasta, xisaabi sin θ ÷ cos θ si aad u hesho tan θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ma aha sin²θ + cos²θ = 1. sin²θ waa 0.36. Hubi waxa labajibaarka cos θ waajib yahay.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Wuxuu buuxiyaa tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c2: tan θ × cos θ ma le'ka sin θ = 0.6. Mar kale hel tan θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.explain: Haddii cos θ = 0.8, markaas tan θ = 0.6 ÷ 0.8 = 0.75, haddii cos θ = −0.8 na, tan θ = −0.75. Labadan waa dhammaan waxa suurtagal ah.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.prompt: Waxaan rabnaa inaan weydiino macluumaad dheeraad ah si loo doorto u dhexeeya labada suurtagalnimo. Dooro dhammaan macluumaadka hoose ee, marka lagu daro sin θ = 3/5, go'aamin lahaa (cos θ, tan θ) si gaar ah xitaa haddii kaliya la bixiyo.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.0: Geli labada musharax (0.8, 0.75) iyo (−0.8, −0.75) shuruudda doorasho kasta.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kala sooc doorashooyinka labada musharax ay buuxiyaan iyo kuwa mid keliya buuxiyo.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.b: 0 iyo π u dhexeeya waxaa jira xagallo rubuca koowaad iyo labaad labadaba. Arag haddii labada musharax ay hadhaan.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.c: Xaqiiqada ah cos θ + sin θ < 1
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.d: Xaqiiqada ah θ waa xagal rubuca koowaad ama labaad
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.d: Haddii sin θ>0, tan horay ayaa la og yahay. Hubi haddii ay tahay macluumaad cusub.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.e: Labada musharax labadooduba, cos θ ma aha 0. Hubi haddii uu kala saari karo labada.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.f: Xaqiiqada ah sin θ × cos θ > 0
y-m-60-04.s.s3.explain: Musharaxiinta waa (0.8, 0.75) iyo (−0.8, −0.75). a: tan θ<0 waxaa buuxiya kan labaad oo keliya. c: cos θ + sin θ waa 1.4 kan koowaad iyo −0.2 kan labaad, sidaas darteed <1 waxaa buuxiya kan labaad oo keliya. f: sin θ × cos θ>0 macnaheedu waa cos θ>0, sidaas darteed kan koowaad oo keliya ayaa buuxiya. b, d, iyo e waxaa buuxiya labada musharaxba, sidaas darteed ma kala saari karaan.

y-m-60-01.title: Hal xal oo keliya? Xagee ayuu shaqadu ku khaldantay?
y-m-60-01.topic: Sifooyinka logaritamka iyo shuruudda doodda: xalalka log₂(x²)=4
y-m-60-01.goal: Baro in tallaabo adeegsanaysa sifo logaritam ay beddeli karto xadka loo oggol yahay ee x, hel khadka halka xalalku ka lumaan oo hagaaji, oo soo xulo tallaabooyinka aan beddelin xadka.
y-m-60-01.material: Suho ayaa xalliyey isleegga log₂(x²) = 4 (x waa tiro dhab ah oo aan eber ahayn) sida hoose ka muuqata. (Sida loo akhriyo: log₂ A waa 'logaritamka A oo salkiisu yahay 2', x² na waa 'x labajibbaaran'.)
y-m-60-01.thinking.0: Hubi in khad kasta uu run yahay isla shuruudaha khadka ka horreeya
y-m-60-01.thinking.1: Hubi xalalka adigoo si toos ah u geliya
y-m-60-01.thinking.2: Isbarbar dhig xadka la oggol yahay beddelka ka hor iyo ka dib
y-m-60-01.prereq.0: Qeexidda iyo sifooyinka logaritamka (doodda waa inay noqotaa togan, log M^k = k·log M waxaa la isticmaalaa marka M>0)
y-m-60-01.prereq.1: Xiriirka tirooyinka leh qiimo saafi ah iyo labajibbaaran isku mid ah
y-m-60-01.prereq.2: Kani waa heer adkaan hawshan (H3), maaha qoondayn sannad dugsiyeed, wuxuuna u malaynayaa inaad horey u bartay sifooyinka tilmaamayaasha iyo logaritamyada.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal khad oo xalka Suho ku khaldan.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig in khad kasta uu run yahay isla xadka x ee khadka ka horreeya.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.1: Geli hal x taban isleegga asalka ah oo hubi in qiimaha la qeexay.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed xalka keliya waa x = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.explain: Khadka 2 waa halka uu ku khaldamo. log₂ x waxaa la isticmaali karaa kaliya marka x uu togan yahay, laakiin isleegga asalka ahi weli macne buu leeyahay marka x uu taban yahay, sababtoo ah x² waa togan. Khadka 2 wuxuu ka tagayaa kiiska x<0, natiijadana sheegashada 'hal keliya' ee khadka 5 waa gunaanad khaldan. Khadka 5 sidoo kale waxaa loo aqbalaa khad khaldan. Xitaa x = −4 wuxuu bixiyaa log₂ 16 = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo geli laba tiro dhab ah oo kala duwan x oo buuxiya isleegga asalka ah log₂(x²) = 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.0: Adigoo isticmaalaya qeexidda logaritamka, dib u qor log₂ A = 4 sida xiriir u dhexeeya A iyo 2.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.1: Geli x aad heshay log₂(x²) asalka ah oo hubi inaad hesho 4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Haddii x=0, markaas x²=0, sidaas darteed doodda logaritamku ma aha togan.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Qiimaha log₂(x²) maaha 4. Mar kale ka fikir awood 2 ah oo bixisa x².
y-m-60-01.s.s2.explain: Qeexidda logaritamka, x² = 2⁴ = 16, sidaas darteed x = 4 ama x = −4. Labada qiime labaduba waxay buuxiyaan isleegga asalka ah, sidaas darteed waxaa jira laba xal.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.prompt: Beddel sida khadka 2 ee Suho wuxuu beddeli karaa xadka x ee la oggol yahay. Dooro dhammaan beddelaadyada hoose ee 'xadka qiimayaasha x qaadan karo uu isku mid yahay ka hor iyo ka dib'. (x waa tiro dhab ah.)
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.0: Dhinaca bidix iyo midigta doorasho kasta, si gooni ah u qor 'xadkee x ku jirto si qiimaha logaritamka gudihiisu u noqdo togan', oo isbarbar dhig.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.1: Doorashooyinka xadadku u muuqdaan kuwo kala duwan, geli hal x taban labada dhinac.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.a: Dhinaca midig macne wuu leeyahay kaliya marka x>0, halka dhinaca bidix u baahan yahay x≠0 oo keliya. Geli x=−4 labada dhinac.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.b: Isbarbar dhig in shuruudda x/3 inuu togan yahay ay la mid tahay shuruudda x inuu togan yahay.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.c: Dhinaca bidix sidoo kale macne wuu leeyahay marka x<0 ama x>2. Ka fikir xadka dhinaca midig macne ku leeyahay.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.d: Dhinaca bidix macne wuu leeyahay kaliya marka x>0, halka dhinaca midig macne leeyahay xitaa marka x uu taban yahay. Xadku wuu ballaaday.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.e: Shuruudda |x| inuu togan yahay waa isla x≠0. Hubi in x taban uu ku jiro.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.explain: Gudaha b, x/3>0 ⇔ x>0, sidaas darteed xaddu waa isku mid, gudaha e, |x|>0 ⇔ x≠0, sidaas darteed xaddu waa isku mid. Gudaha a, x<0 wuu lumayaa; gudaha c, dhinaca x<0 wuu lumayaa; gudaha d, xadku wuu ballaadhayaa dhinaca kale. Beddel beddela xadka wuxuu keeni karaa lumis ama kasbasho xalal, sidaas darteed kadib beddelka waa inaad dib ugu gelisaa isleegga asalka ah si aad u hubiso.

y-m-60-07.title: Hubinta xal helaya eraygii guud ee qaacidada wadarta
y-m-60-07.topic: Wadarta isku-xigga iyo eraygiisa guud: hubinta eraygii koowaad marka laga helo aₙ Sₙ
y-m-60-07.goal: Xal helaya eraygii guud ee wadarta Sₙ, hel halka malo-awaalka n≥2 uu ka maqan yahay, ku hubi tirooyin gaar ah, oo naftaada u dhis qaacido wadar ah oo eraygii koowaad aan loo baahnayn in si gooni ah loo go'aamiyo.
y-m-60-07.material: Isku-xigga {aₙ}, wadarta eraygii koowaad ilaa eraygii n waa Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 (n waa tiro dabiici ah), Eunwoo-na wuxuu helay eraygii guud sida hoose. (Sida loo akhriyo: aₙ waa 'eraygii n', Sₙ waa 'wadarta eraygii koowaad ilaa eraygii n', Sₙ₋₁-na waa 'wadarta ilaa eraygii (n−1)'.)
y-m-60-07.thinking.1: Gabagabada ku hubi tirooyin gaar ah
y-m-60-07.thinking.2: Naftaada u dhis qaacido buuxisa shuruudaha
y-m-60-07.prereq.0: Xidhiidhka u dhexeeya wadarta Sₙ iyo eraygii guud aₙ ee isku-xigga (Sₙ waa wadarta eraygii koowaad ilaa eraygii n)
y-m-60-07.prereq.2: Kani waa heer adag oo hawshan ah (H3), ma aha qoondayn fasal, waxayna u qaadanaysaa inaad dhammaysay cutubka isku-xiggayaasha.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar oo xalka Eunwoo ah halka uu ku khaldamay.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.0: Si toos ah u barbar dhig gabagabada a₁ = 3 iyo qeexidda S₁ (wadarta eraygii koowaad ilaa eraygii koowaad).
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg waxa Sₙ₋₁ noqonayo marka aad gelisid n=1 qaacidada sadarka 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed tiro dabiici ah n kasta, aₙ = 2n + 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed eraygii koowaad waa a₁ = 3.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 1 wuxuu sii jiraa marka n≥2 keliya. S₀ lama qeexin, sidaas darteed looma isticmaali karo n=1. Sidaas darteed 'tiro dabiici ah n kasta' ee sadarka 4 iyo a₁ = 3 ee sadarka 5 waa khalad. Eraygii koowaad waa a₁ = S₁ = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. Xisaabaha sadarrada 2 iyo 3 (2n+1 ee n≥2) waa sax. Doorashada mid ka mid ah sadarka 1, sadarka 4, ama sadarka 5 waa la aqbalaa.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.prompt: Sₙ = pn² + qn + r (p, q, r waa tirooyin dhan, p≥1), S₃ = 21, eraygii koowaad a₁ = S₁ na waa ugu yaraan 1. Kiiskan, hel laba qiimood oo kala duwan oo p ah oo qiimaha lagu helay gelinta n=1 qaacidada aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ (ee n≥2) uu le'eg yahay S₁ (taasoo ah, kiisaska eraygii koowaad aan loo baahnayn in si gooni ah loo go'aamiyo), oo gali.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.0: Si toos ah u xisaabi Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ ee pn² + qn + r oo ka dhig odhaah ku saabsan n.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hel shuruudda ka dhigaysa qiimaha odhaahdaas marka n=1 inuu le'eg yahay S₁ = p + q + r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c1: p, q, r waa tirooyin dhan iyo p≥1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p, q, r waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan, p-na waa inuu noqdaa ugu yaraan 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Eraygii koowaad S₁ waa ugu yaraan 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c3: S₁ = p + q + r wuu ka yar yahay 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c4: Qiimaha qaacidada n≥2 marka n=1 wuxuu le'eg yahay S₁.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c4: Gelinta n=1 qaacidada 2pn + (q−p) ee n≥2 waxay bixisaa p+q. Hubi qiime noocee ah ayuu r waajib yahay si ay u le'eg tahay S₁ = p+q+r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.explain: Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ = 2pn + (q − p), gelinta n=1 na waxay bixisaa p + q. Si ay u le'eg tahay S₁ = p + q + r, r = 0 ayaa loo baahan yahay. Markaas S₃ = 9p + 3q = 21, taasoo ah 3p + q = 7, labo-labooyinka tirooyinka dhan ee buuxiya S₁ ≥ 1 na waa (p, q) = (1, 4), (2, 1), (3, −2). Tusaale ahaan, haddii Sₙ = 3n² − 2n, markaas aₙ = 6n − 5 sidoo kale wuu shaqaynayaa marka n=1 (a₁ = 1).
y-m-60-07.s.s3.prompt: Hal ama laba weedh ku qor, adigoo isticmaalaya ugu yaraan hal qiime oo gaar ah (tiro), sababta ay khalad u tahay in aₙ = 2n + 1 loo isticmaalo n kasta ee Eunwoo Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.0: Eeg waxa Sₙ₋₁ yahay marka n=1 ee aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ ee Eunwoo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.1: Dhinac dhinac u qor qiimaha S₁ ee si toos ah loo xisaabiyay iyo qiimaha 2n+1 marka n=1.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma isticmaashay xaqiiqada ah a₁ wuxuu le'eg yahay S₁ si aad u hesho 6?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma muujisay is-waafajin la'aanta adigoo barbar dhigaya qiimaha 2n+1 marka n=1?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay sidoo kale in qaacidadan la isticmaali karo n≥2 oo keliya?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.0: a₁ waa S₁, sidaas darteed waa 1 + 2 + 3 = 6, laakiin gelinta n=1 2n + 1 waxay bixisaa 3, sidaas darteed way kala duwan yihiin. Sidaas darteed qaacidadan waa la isticmaali karaa n≥2 oo keliya, eraygii koowaad na waa in si gooni ah loo helaa.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.1: Eraygii koowaad waa S₁ = 6. Laakiin gelinta n=1 aₙ = 2n+1 waxay bixisaa 3, sidaas darteed waa khalad. Si loo isticmaalo Sₙ₋₁, n waa inay noqotaa ugu yaraan 2, sidaas darteed n=1 waa in si gooni ah loo hubiyaa.
